close_reason: fixed by PKIX-onc.9 fix (clone→move in TryFrom)
description: TryFrom<Certificate> for TrustAnchor (lib.rs ~L302-303) takes cert by value but calls .clone() on cert.tbs_certificate.subject and .subject_public_key_info before dropping cert. Both fields are heap-allocated (Name = Vec<RelativeDistinguishedName>, SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned = owned BitString). They should be moved, not cloned. Impact: 2 unnecessary heap allocations per TrustAnchor construction via TryFrom, affecting callers that build trust stores at startup or during OCSP/CRL anchor construction.
title: TryFrom<Certificate>: needless clone of subject/SPKI
